verdict.rationale: Docs show agents respond to explicit mentions in comments (docs-23) and can be resumed after pausing (docs-35), suggesting some mechanism to redirect an in-progress agent, but there is no explicit documented API or UI feature for sending a mid-session follow-up instruction/steering message to a running agent without restarting. Missing for 10: explicit 'send message to active agent run' endpoint/UI, confirmation that resume preserves context with new instructions, and independent/hands-on verification that steering mid-task works as described.
